findings.title: Listener cleanup is gated on the wrong feature flag for V2
findings.body: The event handling block is gated on Profile.Feature.ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ (V1), but this PR is for ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ_V2. When only V2 is enabled, removal events for roles, clients, and groups are ignored, so associated admin permission resources/policies are not cleaned up. Conversely, if both V1 and V2 are enabled, management() returns MgmtPermissionsV2 and clients().setPermissionsEnabled() throws UnsupportedOperationException, so client removal events can cause a server error. The check should use ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ_V2, and the V2 evaluator must implement the cleanup path.

findings.title: getClientsWithPermission filters by a type that per-client resources do not have
findings.body: resourceStore.findByType is called with AdminPermissionsSchema.CLIENTS_RESOURCE_TYPE, but per-client resources created by AdminPermissionsSchema.getOrCreateResource are created without calling setType, so they will not be returned by this query. The all-clients type resource itself does match and its name "Clients" is added to the result as if it were a client ID. As a result, the returned set does not contain the actual client IDs needed for admin list filtering, regardless of whether specific-client or all-client permissions are granted.

findings.title: getResourceName does not resolve client resources added in this PR
findings.body: getResourceName only handles the Users resource type. Client-specific resources are named by the client UUID and are created without a display name, so for the newly added Clients resource type this method falls through to resource.getDisplayName() and returns a null or otherwise meaningless value. This breaks human-readable permission/resource descriptions for client resources. A CLIENTS branch should resolve the ClientModel and return its clientId, similar to the existing user branch.
